notes.title: Fixed a few bugs!
notes.content:
We just released an update to Slide!! that fixes the following issues:
[list]
[*] Levels created on one platform (Windows/Mac/Linux) were not playable on other platforms (due to a difference in the date format)
[*] When uploading a level to the Workshop, the description will now include the Target Moves and Target Times automatically (see example below)
[*] Re-enabled post-processing (which was turned off in the last update)
[*] 'Turbo Mode' is now OFF by default (for new players)
[/list]

If you experience any problems with the game then do please give us a shout!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30824948/c05676c9204288c6bb529e67af5fc2ab87e3e76a.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Slide!! just got a massive update!
notes.content:
The new version of Slide!! has just been released and there are a lot of new features:

[list]
[*]Built-in level editor
[*]Steam Workshop integration
[*]Turbo Mode!
[*]Various bug fixes and improvements
[/list]

We hope the level editor is as user-friendly as can be but we will add guides and tutorials as needed. You can upload your levels to Steam Workshop directly from the editor but you must first play test them to prove that the "target time" and "target moves" are achievable.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30824948/263d6d7fbb7d391d4e7be2e6fc9b48987d8be285.jpg[/img]

You can "Get Levels" from the Steam Workshop while in-game. Go to the PLAY menu and select "Downloaded Levels". There is a button labelled "GET LEVELS" and this will open the Steam overlay and take you straight to the Workshop. Subscribe to as many levels as you want and Steam will automatically download the levels to your machine. Go back to the game and click on "Refresh" to see the levels and then start playing!

We look forward to playing your creations!

This new version also includes "Turbo Mode". This makes time go at double speed which is useful if you want to experiment to find solutions to a level. When you have found a solution you can turn Turbo Mode off (via the Pause screen) and this will allow you to set the best possible time for a level.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30824948/1fd9a1e173ae8b8dba7885ee307d90c238147e70.png[/img]

Enjoy!

notes.title: Turbo Mode!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30824948/1fd9a1e173ae8b8dba7885ee307d90c238147e70.png[/img]

As well as the new level editor and Steam Workshop integration, the new version of Slide!! will include a "Turbo Mode"...because sometimes you are in a hurry and you can't wait around for those Sliders to go at their own speed! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Steam Workshop Update coming shortly
notes.content:
We've been busy adding a level editor to Slide!! and integrating the game with Steam Workshop. We are in the final testing stages at the moment and will be releasing the new version very soon.

Here's a sneak peek at the editor:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30824948/faa608fc290d9e23ad7567c82d8ad62e557d632b.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Slide!! is coming to Steam very soon!
notes.content:
We've been getting the Steam version of Slide!! ready (with the addition of achievements and better graphics) and soon you will be able to play the game on Windows, Mac and Linux/SteamOS.

We hope you will enjoy the 100 levels and we wonder who will be the first to "3 star" all of them?
